messages:
maya: Heads-up — prepping marketplace onboarding for AcmeCloud partner. Need localized Terraform modules + CI pipeline for the marketplace artifacts. Who can pick up template localization + partner docs?
jordan: I can lead the Terraform module updates. Thinking separate modules per cloud region and a small examples/dir for quickstarts.
sam: Important: partner requires ARM64 build instructions and a smoke test matrix (amd64 + arm64). Also need a minimal accepted-healthcheck test.
lee: We'll need acceptance criteria for the listing: tested TF module, sample app, ARM64/AMD artifacts, license + partner metadata (publisher, support contact).
maya: Agree. Also need automation to generate marketplace artifacts from the module. Suggest GH Actions matrix + Terratest or kitchen-terraform for smoke tests.
jordan: Prototype GH Action (WIP):
```
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch: [amd64, arm64]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Terraform
        uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v1
      - run: make test
```
sam: Add a lightweight acceptance test: spin up a tiny model-server (small open model), call /health and one sample generate. Keep it <5 min. Use a cached image and ephemeral infra.
lee: @jordan can you include a scripts/localize.sh that copies variables and sets cloud-specific defaults? Also add metadata.json for the marketplace UI (publisher, tags, support_url).
jordan: Yep. Proposed repo layout:
```
modules/
  redwood-llm/
    main.tf
    variables.tf
    outputs.tf
examples/
  quickstart/
    README.md
.github/
  workflows/ci.yml
scripts/localize.sh
docs/partners/partner-onboarding-checklist.md
```
maya: Docs: one page 'Partner Onboarding checklist' with acceptance criteria + sample PR template. I will draft and put it in /docs/partners.
jordan: I'll open the repo and push a WIP branch by EOD. tagging @lee @sam for review.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: marketplace-staging in 2 hours (automated)
lee: :thumbsup: also can we add a runnable demo (docker-compose) for SI teams to run locally? They like quick demos.
sam: Yes — docker-compose for quickstart + a note how to switch to k8s (manifest snips). Keep it single-container for smoke.
maya: Great. I'll compile bullets for the partner handoff doc and ping PM and legal for the metadata fields. Meeting to review the checklist + CI on Thu 10:00 PT?
jordan: Works for me.
lee: Works for me.
maya: Thanks — adding task list to this thread and will link the draft doc PR once ready.
